what: Named entitlement profiles for the Design Center's customization capability. Test data only: the loader in server/customization-gate.ts reads this file only when DIOMEDES_TEST_MODE=1 and DIOMEDES_ENTITLEMENT_FIXTURE names a profile, so a production build with neither set never opens it. A profile is a fixture, not a purchase: nothing here is evidence anybody paid for anything.
planNote: plan_business is the fixture id for Diomedes Business, the lowest paid software tier in docs/business/PRICING_STRATEGY_2026-09-15.md (version 2026-09-17.2). Prices live in that document, never here and never in code.

free.why: A person with no plan. Built-in schemes, text and zoom size, contrast, reduced motion, texture off, focus visibility and reset all work; nothing premium does.

paid.why: The lowest paid software tier, which includes advanced customization.

designer.why: No plan, and the launch-time design authoring authorization is on. Local scope authoring only, never organization activation and never agent authority.

snapshot.reason: No plan covers this installation; design authoring was authorized at launch.

unauthorized.why: An active plan that does not include customization. Paying for something is not paying for this, and the plan id is the check.

snapshot.reason: This plan does not include advanced customization.

offline.why: The entitlement service could not be asked. Unknown is a real state and refuses like none; it never reads as active.

snapshot.reason: The plan could not be checked from this computer.

downgraded.why: A plan that was active and has been revoked. The snapshot still says active as written; observation time is what reads it as revoked.
